Title: HTML Injection / Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Swagger UI and ReDoc HTML Generation
Analysis:
The `get_swagger_ui_html` and `get_redoc_html` functions in `fastapi/openapi/docs.py` format an HTML string using Python f-strings, inserting parameter values like `swagger_js_url`, `swagger_css_url`, `swagger_favicon_url`, `redoc_js_url`, and `redoc_favicon_url` directly into the template without HTML sanitization or escaping.

If a developer allows user-supplied parameters or queries to customize the docs URLs (e.g., dynamically generated based on a request query or parameter) or if an attacker can control these values, they can inject arbitrary HTML tags or break out of attributes to perform Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).

For instance, if `swagger_js_url` is set to `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swagger-ui-dist@5.9.0/swagger-ui-bundle.js\"></script><script>alert(1)</script>`, the generated HTML output will contain:
`<script src=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swagger-ui-dist@5.9.0/swagger-ui-bundle.js\"></script><script>alert(1)</script>\"></script>`
which executes arbitrary JS code in the context of the user's browser session.

Similarly, injecting `swagger_css_url` as `\"><script>alert(1)</script>` will result in:
`<link type=\"text/css\" rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"\"><script>alert(1)</script>\">`

This represents a classic XSS vulnerability via unsanitized formatting of HTML templates.

Title: HTML Injection / Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in ReDoc HTML Generation
Analysis:
Similarly to the Swagger HTML generation, the `get_redoc_html` function in `fastapi/openapi/docs.py` interpolates the `redoc_js_url` and `redoc_favicon_url` directly into an HTML string using Python f-strings without any sanitization or HTML escaping.

If an attacker can control or influence these URLs (for example, in configurations where sub-paths or tenant-level configurations determine these URLs dynamically based on external data), they can construct a payload to inject custom HTML elements such as `<script>` tags, causing Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).

Conceptual payload for `redoc_js_url`:
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/redoc@next/bundles/redoc.standalone.js\"></script><script>alert(1)</script>`

This payload breaks out of the `<script src=\"{redoc_js_url}\">` element and executes arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser session.
